claim: Demo changes, reset, and exit never read or alter a real setup.
sandbox: fresh browser context; preseed real settings; modify and reset demo; start for real; compare exact real values

claim: The demo opens with three sample gestures and populated controller output.
where: landing first screen, demo first screen
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert sample thresholds, mappings, ready count, and active output

claim: Users can calibrate low, high, and held vocal gestures.
sandbox: fresh /demo context with deterministic 220 Hz and 330 Hz microphone buffers; complete all three samples

claim: Low, high, and held gestures map to configurable browser actions.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; preview all three gestures, then remap low and assert changed controller output

claim: Microphone audio is analyzed on the device and creates no upload request.
where: landing facts, calibration UI, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo context with deterministic microphone; record network requests during start, analysis, and stop

claim: Sing Switch does not record, retain, transcribe, identify, or train on voice audio.
sandbox: fresh /demo context with recorder and speech-recognition sentinels; run microphone path; inspect browser stores

claim: A real setup stores only calibration thresholds and mappings in localStorage.
sandbox: start at /demo, leave for a clean real setup, change controls, and validate the complete localStorage contents

claim: Controller changes dispatch a versioned sing-switch browser event.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; subscribe to the public event and assert the emitted high-action detail

claim: Mapped actions emit synthetic keyboard events.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; capture keydown while previewing high and assert ArrowUp

claim: Generated keyboard events are not trusted operating-system input.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; capture the generated ArrowDown event and assert isTrusted is false

claim: The current calibration and five gesture mappings export as JSON.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; download and parse the file; validate product, version, calibration, and five mappings

claim: The live controller state can be copied as JSON.
sandbox: fresh /demo context with clipboard permission; copy, parse, and validate the current controller state

claim: An optional WebSocket sends controller JSON and never audio.
where: controller output section, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo context with an in-browser WebSocket receiver; inspect every sent message and its exact fields

claim: Keyboard controls provide an equivalent path through the test game.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; use ArrowDown, ArrowUp, and Space to complete all three gates in three attempts

claim: Sing Switch works offline after the first visit, including the populated demo and legal pages.
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context at /demo; wait for service worker; go offline; reload demo, privacy, and landing routes

claim: Sing Switch has no accounts, ads, tracking cookies, fingerprinting, or third-party analytics.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; record the whole sample, preview, game, and privacy flow; assert same-origin requests and no cookies

claim: The sample, test game, and JSON export are free and require no account.
sandbox: fresh /demo context without credentials; start the game and export the mapping without a login or checkout

claim: Sing Switch does not provide speech recognition, voice identity, or anti-cheat input.
sandbox: fresh /demo context with speech API sentinels; run microphone input; inspect controller schema and API use

claim: Reset setup deletes saved real calibration and mappings.
sandbox: start at /demo, enter real mode, save a mapping, reset, and assert both real storage keys are absent

claim: Microphone access starts only after the user asks and stops when listening stops.
sandbox: fresh /demo context with microphone and track-stop counters; inspect before start, after start, and after stop
